# Action Cache lookup and store

## When to use this guide

You are integrating Bazel, Buck2, or Pants directly via the REAPI v2 Go
stubs and need a typed wrapper around `ActionCache.GetActionResult` and
`ActionCache.UpdateActionResult`.

If you only need CAS get/put, see [02-upload-blob](./02-upload-blob.mdx) and
[03-download-blob](./03-download-blob.mdx).

## Lookup

```go
func getOrRun(ctx context.Context, cli *corelink.Client, actionDigest string) ([]byte, error) {
    result, err := cli.ActionCache().Get(ctx, actionDigest)
    if errors.Is(err, corelink.ErrActionCacheMiss) {
        return runLocallyAndStore(ctx, cli, actionDigest)
    }
    if err != nil {
        return nil, err
    }
    return cli.Get(ctx, result.StdoutDigest)
}
```

## Store

```go
func storeResult(ctx context.Context, cli *corelink.Client,
    actionDigest string, stdout []byte, exitCode int32,
) error {
    stdoutDigest, err := cli.Put(ctx, stdout)
    if err != nil {
        return err
    }
    return cli.ActionCache().Put(ctx, actionDigest, &corelink.ActionResult{
        StdoutDigest: stdoutDigest,
        ExitCode:     exitCode,
    })
}
```

## TTL and eviction

```go
err := cli.ActionCache().Put(ctx, actionDigest, result,
    corelink.WithTTL(24*time.Hour),
)
```

## Cache poisoning protection

Server-side verification rejects any `ActionResult` whose declared
`stdout_digest` does not match the bytes already stored under that digest.
You cannot lie about what an action produced.
